description: Preview and price a request for advice from other AI labs, before anything is sent. Nothing is sent, written or spent. Put the decision in `brief` (at most 48,000 characters in all; over the limit is refused, never cut; no invisible characters; no transcript, tool output, environment or file listing; `not_included` says what you left out). `sensitivity` can only tighten the operator's policy, `unknown` counts as confidential, and personal data or secret-adjacent material is never sent. Returns who would receive the text (lab, model, the endpoint's retention wording), its exact size and sha256 after emails, IBANs, cards, IPs, internal hosts and home paths are masked, the worst-case and expected price, and a quote_id valid for ten minutes to pass to council_advise. mode "single" asks one non-Anthropic model, chosen by `advisor` (the shipped default is GPT-6.1 Sol; Claude, the usual caller, and /advisor are not asked); mode "council" asks several labs and is for decisions that are hard to undo. A refusal says what to change and is final for that brief: do not retry it unchanged.

advisor.description: single mode only: which model advises (default sol = GPT-6.1 Sol)

constraints.description: hard limits the answer must respect

decision_at_stake.description: what you will do differently depending on the answer, and what is costly or hard to undo if it is wrong

excerpts.description: decision-relevant excerpts only; at most 36,000 characters together

why_needed.description: which part of the question this answers and why the advisors cannot answer without it

first_look.description: true only when nothing has been tried yet because the choice comes before any work

new_evidence.description: only when asking again about the same question: what you found or changed since; a rephrasing does not count

not_included.description: what you left out on purpose: transcript, environment, file listings, tool output

options_considered.description: at least two real options; "do nothing", "do less" and "do not build" count

question.description: one answerable question, in your own words; not a task description

sensitivity.description: your own label; it can only tighten the operator policy; "unknown" counts as confidential

tried.description: what you already tried or checked and what each try showed; required unless first_look

max_usd.description: the most this call may spend; can only lower the limit

mode.description: single: one non-Anthropic model; council: three labs, for hard-to-undo decisions

name: council_quote
title: Preview and price a request for outside advice
